description: React functional component 'Dashboard' serving as the main page for content generation, editing, preview, and export functionalities. It manages state for content, post ID, and export modal visibility, and composes various child components such as GeneratorPanel, Editor, Preview, HistoryList, and ExportModal.

methods.name: onContentReady
methods.description: Callback invoked when new content data is ready; updates content state and post ID.

methods.name: onSaved
methods.description: Callback invoked when content is saved; updates post ID.
